title: FinOps & FOCUS Cost Watch
blurb: A running record of the Microsoft Learn pages and the versioned FOCUS specification behind Copilot cost reporting in FinOps terms — the FinOps Framework, the FOCUS open standard, and the Azure Cost Management FOCUS export schema. These are the definitions the Hub's FinOps & FOCUS Cost Report and Consumption Central conform to.

docs.title: What is FOCUS?
docs.why: Microsoft's overview of the FOCUS open cost-and-usage standard. Definition changes here change what FOCUS-aligned reports must conform to.

docs.title: FOCUS cost and usage details (dataset schema)
docs.why: THE column-level FOCUS export schema in Azure Cost Management. Any column rename or definition change directly affects the FinOps & FOCUS Cost Report.

docs.title: Create exports with FOCUS (Cost Management)
docs.why: How FOCUS-format cost exports are produced — the pipeline the Cowork cost reports read from.

docs.title: Cost Management dataset schema index
docs.why: The index of all Cost Management export schemas — new dataset versions appear here first.

docs.title: The FinOps Framework
docs.why: Microsoft's mapping to the FinOps Foundation framework capabilities — the conceptual model the reports align to.
